# Math.net

> A comprehensive K-12 mathematics learning platform covering foundational arithmetic through advanced calculus with interactive tutorials and reference materials.

Math.net provides structured learning paths from primary mathematics through algebra, geometry, trigonometry, and probability & statistics. The site combines instructional guides with reference definitions to support both learning and quick concept lookup.

## Key Topics

- Trigonometric functions
- Unit circle
- Quadratic formula
- Right triangle
- Sine, cosine, tangent
- Algebra basics
- Geometry fundamentals
- Probability theory
- Variables and functions
- Arithmetic operations
- Solving equations
- Polygons and polyhedrons
- Statistics
- Set operations
- PEMDAS/BODMAS

## Elementary Mathematics

- [Primary Math](https://www.math.net/primary-math): Elementary math foundations including PEMDAS, BODMAS, and measurement systems
- [Counting](https://www.math.net/counting): Guide to counting basics, skip counting, and early number sense development
- [Addition](https://www.math.net/addition): Tutorial on addition fundamentals and arithmetic properties
- [Multiplication](https://www.math.net/multiplication): Guide to multiplication, factors, arrays, and area models

## Algebra

- [Algebra](https://www.math.net/algebra): Introduction to algebra, variables, equations, and algebraic notation
- [Variable](https://www.math.net/variable): Definition and explanation of variables, coefficients, and constants
- [Function](https://www.math.net/function): Reference on function definition, domain, and vertical line test
- [Solving equations](https://www.math.net/solving-equations): Guide to solving equations and quadratic formula application

## Trigonometry

- [Trigonometry](https://www.math.net/trigonometry): Introduction to trigonometry, functions, and unit circle concepts
- [Sine](https://www.math.net/sine): Definition and properties of sine trigonometric function
- [Cosine](https://www.math.net/cosine): Definition and properties of cosine trigonometric function
- [Tangent](https://www.math.net/tangent): Definition and properties of tangent trigonometric function

## Geometry

- [Geometry](https://www.math.net/geometry): Overview of plane and solid geometry, shapes, and fundamental concepts
- [Line](https://www.math.net/line): Definition of lines, angles, parallel and perpendicular relationships
- [Plane](https://www.math.net/plane): Definition and properties of planes in 2D and 3D geometry
- [Shape](https://www.math.net/shape): Classification of 2D and 3D shapes including polygons and polyhedrons

## Probability and Statistics

- [Probability and Statistics](https://www.math.net/probability-and-statistics): Fundamentals of probability theory and statistical concepts
- [Random variable](https://www.math.net/random-variable): Explanation of random variables and probability distributions
- [Basic set operations](https://www.math.net/basic-set-operations): Reference on set theory operations including union and intersection

## Core

- [Learn and Practice Math - Math.net](https://www.math.net): Math.net homepage covering K-12 math topics from algebra to calculus
